sentences.text: CONVICTION SENTENCE U/s 450 of IPC R.I. for 05 years and fine of Rs.1,000/-, in default of payment of fine, additional R.I. for 01 month U/s 506-II of IPC R.I. for 03 years and fine of Rs.500/-, in default of payment of fine, additional R.I. for 01 month U/s 376(2)(n) of R.I. for 10 years and fine of IPC Rs.2,000/-, in default of payment of fine, additional R.I. for 02 months U/s 376(3) of R.I. for life (which mean that IPC appellant would serve with remaining life with R.I.) and fine of Rs.2,000/-, in default of payment of fine, additional R.I. for 02 months It has been argued by learned counsel for the convict/appellant that the victims is stated to be a consenting party report and the FIR was lodged after one year.
He further submitted the appellant is in jail since 13.03.2020 and the appeal is likely to take some time for its conclusion, hence he prays that the appellant be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that the victim, as per the case of prosecution, is stated to be minor girl aged about 13 years and as per statement made before the trial Court the victim was subjected to intercourse in absence of her parents and further the fact that she could not tell about the said incident to her father because of apprehension of being scolded by the appellant and it is stated that the victim became pregnant and also delivered a child Therefore, he prays that bail application filed by the appellant be rejected.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records of the Court below.

Considering the fact that the victim was a minor girl aged about 13 years at the time of incident and also considering the fact that she was subjected to intercourse in absence of her parents and further the fact that she could not tell about the said incident to her father because of apprehension of being scolded by the appellant, she became pregnant and also delivered a child, at this stage, we deem it appropriate to reject the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Accordingly, IA No.2 of 2024 is rejected.
Let the matter be listed for final hearing after two weeks.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Bibhu Datta Guru) (Ramesh Sinha)
